title: Thread
description: A narrative thread. Own attributes only — state, temperature, debt are computed from segment data, never stored here.

type.description: feud=A-vs-B w/ match payoff; arc=single-character; faction=group cohesion/war; prop=championship/mystery/MITB; meta=brand-level (taboo, draft, brand-war).

opened_at.description: Show id where this thread was first established.

opened_by_segment.description: Specific segment id that opened the thread.

carriers.description: Character ids carrying the thread. May expand as the thread evolves.

promised_payoff.description: What kind of resolution was promised. 'undefined' = open-ended (carries more debt).

promised_payoff_show.description: Required when promised_payoff='specific-show' or 'ppv-match'. References a show id.
